name: IsSRGWith.card_commonNeighbors_eq_of_adj_compl
statement: G.IsSRGWith n k ℓ μ) {v w : V} (ha : Gᶜ.Adj v w) : Fintype.card (Gᶜ.commonNeighbors v w) = n - (2 * k - μ) - 2

name: IsSRGWith.card_commonNeighbors_eq_of_not_adj_compl
statement: G.IsSRGWith n k ℓ μ) {v w : V} (hn : v ≠ w) (hna : ¬Gᶜ.Adj v w) : Fintype.card (Gᶜ.commonNeighbors v w) = n - (2 * k - ℓ)

name: IsSRGWith.compl
statement: G.IsSRGWith n k ℓ μ) : Gᶜ.IsSRGWith n (n - k - 1) (n - (2 * k - μ) - 2) (n - (2 * k - ℓ)) where card
